(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) (objects g 0))))
             (define (square-zeros? zeros)
               (if (empty? zeros)
                   #f
                   (let* ((r0 (min-of fst zeros))
                          (r1 (max-of fst zeros))
                          (c0 (min-of snd zeros))
                          (c1 (max-of snd zeros))
                          (side-r (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                          (side-c (+ 1 (- c1 c0))))
                     (and (= side-r side-c) (= (length zeros) (* side-r side-c))))))
             (define (process acc obj)
               (let* ((zeros (filter (lambda (p) (zero? (at g (fst p) (snd p))))
                                     (bbox-interior-cells (obj-bbox obj)))))
                 (if (square-zeros? zeros) (paint-cells acc zeros 2) acc)))
             (reduce process g objs)))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) (objects g 0))))
     (define (square-zeros? zeros)
       (if (empty? zeros)
           #f
           (let* ((r0 (min-of fst zeros))
                  (r1 (max-of fst zeros))
                  (c0 (min-of snd zeros))
                  (c1 (max-of snd zeros))
                  (side-r (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                  (side-c (+ 1 (- c1 c0))))
             (and (= side-r side-c) (= (length zeros) (* side-r side-c))))))
     (define (process acc obj)
       (let* ((zeros (filter (lambda (p) (zero? (at g (fst p) (snd p))))
                             (bbox-interior-cells (obj-bbox obj)))))
         (if (square-zeros? zeros) (paint-cells acc zeros 2) acc)))
     (define filled (reduce process g objs))
     (define parts (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects filled 0)))
     (define (center obj)
       (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
         (list (quotient (+ (first bb) (third bb)) 2)
               (quotient (+ (second bb) (fourth bb)) 2))))
     (define (line-cells p q)
       (let ((r1 (first p)) (c1 (second p)) (r2 (first q)) (c2 (second q)))
         (cond
           ((= r1 r2)
            (for/list ((c (in-range (min c1 c2) (+ 1 (max c1 c2))))) (list r1 c)))
           ((= c1 c2)
            (for/list ((r (in-range (min r1 r2) (+ 1 (max r1 r2))))) (list r c1)))
           (else (list)))))
     (for*/fold ((out filled))
                ((i (in-range (length parts)))
                 (j (in-range (+ i 1) (length parts))))
       (let* ((a (list-ref parts i))
              (b (list-ref parts j))
              (pa (center a))
              (pb (center b))
              (cells (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (line-cells pa pb) (list))))
         (if (empty? cells) out (paint-cells out cells 4)))))))
